# @sw-code/eslint-plugin-urbo

ESLint plugin with custom rules for Urbo projects.

## Installation

This package is published to GitHub Packages. Make sure your `.npmrc` has:

```
@sw-code:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com
```

Then install:

```bash
npm install @sw-code/eslint-plugin-urbo --save-dev
```

## Usage

observation.command: cd /workspace && find . -name ".npmrc" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null; echo "===app libs==="; ls app/libs; cat app/libs/eslint-plugin-urbo/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -20
